pool.english: She is a young Emirati entrepreneur.
I want to open a small business.
The profit this month was good.
We had a loss in the first year.
How much capital do you need?
The costs are high: rent, salaries and the licence.
There is a lot of competition in the market.
Study the needs of the market.
She sells abayas through an online store.
Customer satisfaction is the most important thing.
A good partner is like gold.
What are the needs of young people?
An online store for Emirati sweets.
The trade licence took a week.
My small business is a karak café.
Without a feasibility study, it's a gamble.
Online stores are growing in the Gulf.

passages.title: From an Idea to a Business

sentences.arabic: مريم رائدة أعمال إماراتية شابة من الشارقة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: مَريَم رائدة أعمال إماراتية شابّة مِن الشّارقة.
sentences.english: Mariam is a young Emirati entrepreneur from Sharjah.
sentences.transliteration: maryam raa2idat a3maal imaaraatiyya shaabba min ish-shaariga.

sentences.arabic: شافت إن السوق يحتاج حلاوة إماراتية صحية، فسوت دراسة جدوى.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: شافَت إنَّ السّوق يِحتاج حَلاوة إماراتية صِحّية، فسَوَّت دِراسة جَدوى.
sentences.english: She saw that the market needed healthy Emirati sweets, so she did a feasibility study.
sentences.transliteration: shaafat inna is-soog yi7taaj 7alaawa imaaraatiyya si77iyya, f-sawwat diraasat jadwa.

sentences.arabic: طلعت رخصة تجارية وبدت مشروع صغير بمتجر إلكتروني.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: طَلّعَت رُخصة تِجارية وبدَت مَشروع صْغَيِّر بمَتجَر إلكتروني.
sentences.english: She got a trade licence and started a small business with an online store.
sentences.transliteration: talla3at rukhsa tijaariyya w-badat mashroo3 sghayyir b-matjar ilektrooni.

sentences.arabic: بالسنة الأولى كان في خسارة، عشان التكاليف كانت عالية والمنافسة قوية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالسَّنة الأولى كان في خَسارة، عَشان التَّكاليف كانَت عالية والمُنافَسة قَوية.
sentences.english: In the first year there was a loss, because the costs were high and the competition was strong.
sentences.transliteration: bis-sana il-oola kaan fee khasaara, 3ashaan it-takaaleef kaanat 3aalya w-il-munaafasa gawiyya.

sentences.arabic: بس حسنت التسويق على الإنستقرام، والزباين زادوا.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَس حَسَّنَت التَّسويق على الإنستَقرام، والزَّباين زادوا.
sentences.english: But she improved her marketing on Instagram, and the customers increased.

sentences.arabic: الحين، بعد ثلاث سنين، عندها ربح زين وشريك وخمس موظفين.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الحين، بَعد ثَلاث سِنين، عِندها رِبح زين وشَريك وخَمس مْوَظَّفين.
sentences.english: Now, after three years, she makes a good profit and has a partner and five employees.
sentences.transliteration: il-7een, ba3d thalaath sneen, 3indaha rib7 zeen w-shareek w-khams mwadhdhafeen.

sentences.arabic: إبدا صغير، إدرس إحتياجات السوق، وإحسب التكاليف.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إبدا صْغَيِّر، إدرِس إحتِياجات السّوق، وإحسِب التَّكاليف.
sentences.english: Start small, study the needs of the market, and calculate the costs.
sentences.transliteration: ibda sghayyir, idris i7tiyaajaat is-soog, w-i7sib it-takaaleef.

sentences.arabic: كل مشروع فيه مخاطرة، بس بدون مخاطرة ما في ربح.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: كِل مَشروع فيه مُخاطَرة، بَس بدون مُخاطَرة ما في رِبح.
sentences.english: Every business has risk, but without risk there is no profit.
sentences.transliteration: kil mashroo3 fee mukhaatara, bas bidoon mukhaatara ma fee rib7.

sentences.arabic: إختار شريكك زين، ودايما إسمع حق زباينك.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إختار شَريكَك زين، ودايماً إسمَع حَق زَبايِنَك.
sentences.english: Choose your partner carefully, and always listen to your customers.
sentences.transliteration: ikhtaar shareekak zeen, w-daayman isma3 7agg zabaayinak.

scenario.situation: The student pitches a small business idea to an Emirati investor at a startup event in Abu Dhabi.
scenario.studentRole: A would-be entrepreneur learning Gulf Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: The Emirati investor, who asks tough questions.
scenario.goalEnglish: Describe your idea, the market needs and the competition, explain costs, capital and expected profit, and answer questions about risk.
